scores.visual_critic_note: The UI chrome (card, buttons, typography hierarchy) is clean and deliberate, but the main Circle Pack visualization is clipped at the bottom — a hard layout failure — and the edge bundles at low tension render as a dense, illegible tangle of dark lines obscuring the data encoding.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout radius and sunburst radial scaling, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions present on data joins, no bar/area baseline violations; minor: opacityScale defined but appears unused in rendered output.
scores.stress_test_note: The tension slider fires an unthrottled redrawLinks across 300 bundled paths on every mousemove pixel with a guard that references a CSS class never assigned, and the force-layout entry transition is unmanaged and can conflict with subsequent layout switches.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view layout and hover-to-fade interaction manage working memory well, but 300 bundled edges across ~200 nodes converge into a dense central tangle that's unreadable at rest, and up to 10 Tableau categorical colors compound visual search load.
